Subject: MAP & evaluation playbook kickoff (embeddings + reranker perf)

Hi Sarah / Matt —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our discussion, attached is a concise mutual action plan (MAP) and the evaluation playbook we'll run to validate latency/throughput and TTFT for your embedding pipeline + the reranker endpoint. High level: we want to validate that under your target concurrency (60 concurrent QPS-like client connections) we meet p95 latency SLAs and that token throughput scales with batching.

Attached: searchable_map_v1.pdf — summary of milestones, acceptance criteria, and timeline.

Playbook (short):
- Baseline: run 30-min warmup, then 30-min steady-state at target concurrency; measure p50/p95/p99 for: embedding generation (per-doc) and reranker (first-token + end-to-end).
- Load shapes: steady (constant QPS), ramp (10 -> 60 conc over 10m), spike (3x burst for 2m).
- Inputs: 10k representative queries + 100k doc embedding vectors (1536-d).
- Success criteria (Delivery):
  * Embeddings: p95 <= 120ms, throughput >= 1k docs/s (batched).
  * Reranker (end-to-end for top-10 rerank): TTFT p50 <= 60ms, p95 <= 200ms; overall throughput >= 400 req/s at 60 concurrent users.

Proposed MAP milestones and dates:
- 08/11: confirm dataset + firewall/egress rules (you)
- 08/13: infra access & test keys (Redwood)
- 08/14 - 08/15: perf runs and log collection (Redwood ops)
- 08/17: results review and close plan (joint)

Next steps: can you confirm the dataset sample and whether your infra team needs IP allowlist entries? If that schedule works we will reserve the dedicated test window on our side.

Thanks,
Laura

Subject: Internal: run results uploaded — summary below

Team — run completed over weekend. I pushed the raw CSV and logs to the shared Drive folder (link in metadata). High-level summary before the customer call on 08/17:

Test harness notes:
- Load driver: k6 + custom client (replay mix), dataset: 10k queries x 100k doc vectors (1536-d), batch size tuned (embeddings: 384 docs/batch; reranker: rank top-10, batch size 16).
- Warmup: 30m; Run windows: two 20m steady-state windows + 2m spike test each.

Key metrics (steady-state at 60 concurrent simulated users):
- Embeddings endpoint:
  * p50 = 22 ms
  * p95 = 68 ms
  * throughput (docs/s) = 1,320 (sustained)
- Reranker endpoint (top-10 end-to-end):
  * TTFT p50 = 48 ms, p95 = 165 ms, p99 = 290 ms
  * end-to-end latency median = 135 ms, p95 = 310 ms
  * throughput (req/s) = 460 req/s sustained at target concurrency
- Observations: batching and prefix caching reduced effective per-request compute; CPU utilization on CPU workers stayed below 70% while GPU utilization averaged 78% during peak. Spike handling: p95 climbed to ~420ms for reranker during 3x burst, recovered within 35s.

Compliance artifact pack attached (reranker-run-logs-20270815.txt). I'll add slides for the customer call with the graphs tomorrow morning.

M
Marissa

Hi everyone —

Appreciate the quick review. Action items we completed and attachments updated to the Drive folder:
- Added CSV columns: run_mode (continuous_batching|single_request), instance_count, avg_gpu_util
- Drafted mitigation language for the MAP (short):
  * Autoscale policy: add a scale-up threshold at 75% GPU utilization sustained for 45s; scale-down at <45% for 120s.
  * Circuit-breaker: degrade reranker to top-5 results if end-to-end p95 exceeds 400ms for >30s; notify via webhook to your ops channel.
  * Burst runway: provision 25% burst capacity (one extra slice) for scheduled heavy windows — we can reserve this behind the contract.
- Uploaded annotated CSV + the artifact pack to the shared Drive link.

Given the performance observed (embeddings p95 = 68ms; reranker TTFT p95 = 165ms; throughput headroom at ~460 req/s), our recommendation in the MAP is to proceed with the Dedicated 8-GPU slice and a 25% burst reserve. Pricing & SOW appendix draft attached to the Drive folder for procurement.

Tentative close timeline:
- 08/19: final pricing review call (30m)
- 08/23: legal & SOW redline window
- 08/31: signature and kickoff

Sarah — does 08/19 09:00 PT work for the 30m sync? If so I'll send a calendar invite and include the ops folks.

Thanks,
Laura
